description: Source code for the CoalescingFSEventsWatcher class, which monitors file system events on macOS using FSEventStream and coalesces rapid changes to trigger a callback.

classes.name: CoalescingFSEventsWatcher
classes.description: A class that wraps macOS's FSEventStream to monitor file system events with event coalescing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the watcher with paths, queue label, coalesce delay, notification callback, and change callback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the file system event stream to begin monitoring.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the monitoring and invalidates the event stream.

methods.name: handleEvents
methods.description: Handles incoming file system events, applying coalescing to prevent excessive callbacks during rapid changes.
